chapters.purpose: Open on the football question or surprising evidence; spoken hook starts at frame 0.
chapters.visual: Hook card plate with the reviewed opening claim (5-8 words), punched in at frame 0; host, one restrained tactical marker, no separate logo bumper.

chapters.purpose: State the bounded thesis and what evidence will be examined.
chapters.visual: Host framing with a clean chapter roadmap.

chapters.purpose: Establish competition, teams/player, date, tactical context, and limits of the episode.
Explain the structure and mechanisms needed to understand the selected moments.
chapters.visual: Authored pitch-board diagrams; reveal one relationship at a time.

chapters.purpose: Present multiple dated observations or match sequences in a reasoned order.
chapters.visual: Approved exact-context media only where available; otherwise authored diagrams with source cards.

chapters.purpose: Connect the evidence to the tactical explanation and its consequences.
chapters.visual: Host analysis intercut with board traces and restrained sourced data cards.

chapters.purpose: Test the thesis against a counterexample, alternative reading, or uncertainty.
chapters.visual: Return to host; label the limits clearly.

chapters.purpose: Summarize what the evidence supports and give Allen's bounded conclusion.
Short fixed channel sign-off and wordmark.
chapters.visual: Locked mark and tagline; no forced generic CTA.

timeline_event_schema.timebase: Absolute seconds from video start. start_seconds inclusive; end_seconds exclusive. Every event must end after it starts and stay within total duration.
timeline_event_schema.caption_rule: Captions align to narration phrase boundaries, appear only during speech, use at most two lines, and include separate start and end times.

transitions.use: Default between argument beats and chapter content.
Reveal a tactical diagram or move between evidence blocks; use sparingly, no more than one per chapter.

effects.use: Trace one or two tactical runs on approved exact-context footage or authored board graphics.
Emphasize one sourced statistic with its source/date visible.
Subtle background geometry, not an unlicensed club or competition identity.

opening: Spoken football question begins immediately over the hook card plate; identity mark may animate alongside for no more than 0.6 seconds.
ending: Conclusion belongs to Allen; resolve into fixed mark and tagline with restrained signature sound cue.
